aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized administrative authentication (TACACS+, RADIUS, or LDAP) in VersaOS.
cli: set system authentication-order [ tacplus radius local ]
aaa_enabled.notes: Ensure remote servers are configured before enabling authentication-order to prevent administrative lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Restrict remote access to SSH only by disabling Telnet (default on VOS).
secure_vty_transport.notes: Ensure Telnet is deleted or disabled and only SSH is enabled.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Define VTY idle-timeout in minutes (e.g. 10 minutes) under the login hierarchy.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: VersaOS automatically hashes/encrypts all user administrative passwords at rest.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Change or remove default SNMP community strings.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Remove standard default community mapping names.

http_server_disabled.summary: Insecure HTTP administrative access is disabled by default.
http_server_disabled.notes: Ensure secure access by using HTTPS for administrative portals.

ssh_version_2.notes: The VersaOS SSH server natively enforces SSHv2 by default.

cli: set system syslog server 192.168.1.100 selector 1 facility-list [ auth ] level alert
logging_enabled.notes: Add your central remote syslog server IP and log selectors.

management_acl.summary: Restrict administrative SSH access using system services access-lists.
cli: set system services access-list ssh allow [ 192.168.1.0/24 ]
management_acl.notes: Restricts remote SSH connections to your dedicated management networks.

cli: set system login announcement "Authorized Access Only."
login_banner.notes: Define a clear legal warning message for pre-login display.

password_min_length.summary: Configure local administrative password policy restrictions.
password_min_length.notes: Set password minimum length to 8 characters or longer.

ntp_configured.notes: Define upstream NTP time servers for system synchronization.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Map SNMP communities to read-only authorization.
cli: set system snmp community "your_community" authorization read-only
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Do not grant read-write access to SNMP communities.
